title: The Retreat

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Immerse yourself in the serenity of nature by tent camping at The Retreat at Cannon Beach. Surrounded by towering trees and the soothing sounds of the Pacific, our tent sites offer a perfect blend of wilderness and comfort. Natural grassy set tent sites are nestled among the trees in our park & each feature a picnic table and fire ring with grill top. Watch the bunnies that come into your site to eat & play year-round. During fall & winter enjoy a possible visit from our herd of elk. The park also features fire pits for cozy evenings under the stars, as well as easy access to nearby trails and beach areas. services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Hit the open road and park your RV at The Retreat at Cannon Beach, where comfort meets adventure. Our spacious RV sites are equipped with full hookups, ensuring that you have all the conveniences of home while surrounded by the stunning beauty of the Oregon Coast. RV sites are semi-rustic and many of them feature scenic views of Ecola Creek which runs through our park. All RV sites are equipped with picnic tables and fire rings with grill tops. We have two designated disabled sites. Please note that each RV site is unique in what type of RV it can accommodate.
